curriculum_scope: Read-only maintenance and isolated fixture/report generators; native PMX conversion stays in original skills

stages.title: Setup and reference calibration
stages.task: Read-only source-hash, reference and environment-manifest consistency report
stages.never: Install drivers, change scene/camera, select scope or approve setup

stages.title: Import and loss inventory
stages.task: Read-only PMX import inventory/loss summary with explicit unknowns
stages.never: Import models, rewrite PMX, infer lost data or replace correct imports

stages.title: Material diagnosis and Cycles restoration
stages.task: Read-only missing texture/alpha/UV/role warning report from verified inputs
stages.never: Design or overwrite shaders; guess map roles; approve color or alpha

stages.title: Geometry repairs
stages.task: Read-only mesh counts, normal/UV/morph correspondence regression report
stages.never: Edit geometry, repair weights, choose silhouettes or move vertices

stages.title: Native control rig
stages.task: Numeric smoke-test fixtures and reports for bone/control mappings and switches
stages.never: Change rest spaces, solve unfamiliar IK/FK or edit live rigs

stages.title: Animation-ready controls
stages.task: Synthetic expression, reset/keyframe and retarget smoke-fixture report helpers
stages.never: Choose corrective shapes, alter controls or approve animator usability

stages.title: Motion and deformation tests
stages.task: Synthetic held-out regression fixture generators and test summary helpers
stages.never: Run unverified scripts on accepted assets or certify animation qualification

stages.title: Final Cycles look
stages.task: Read-only render configuration and per-region numerical comparison evidence report
stages.never: Judge appearance, optimize shader/lighting creatively or claim Cycles rendering

stages.title: Editable native physics
stages.task: For now, Codex runs physics tests and evaluates collision/secondary motion
stages.never: Local model physics design, parameter fitting or approval

stages.title: Audit and delivery
stages.task: For now, Codex performs actual clean-open, benchmark and human delivery gates
stages.never: Local model delivery approval or fabricated test evidence
